Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the "fifth section alphabetically" under the Federal Rules. In Step 1, the agent listed only three sections (Civil Procedure, Criminal Procedure, Evidence) and incorrectly concluded that the fifth section could not be determined or that the search was insufficient, without actually identifying the correct fifth section (which is the Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure). This fundamental error in identifying the correct legal section led to the subsequent analysis of the wrong rule (Rule 601 of the Evidence Rules instead of Rule 10 of the Appellate Rules), causing the entire task to fail. This matches the pattern of "Overly Broad Search Queries" and "Failure to narrow down results" seen in Example 1.
